title: A key added after a block scalar that ends the file without a line break
notes: The scalar ends at the end of the input. The new member needs a line break before it, which ends the scalar line; the scalar keeps its value `bar`. A missing final line break stays missing, as for the other edits of such files (docs/edit-semantics.md, explicit keys). The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit as one that would not read back.
